verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the GitHub README's thin statement that Weaviate combines vector similarity search with keyword filtering in a single query interface. The llms.txt probe adds that Weaviate stores inverted indexes alongside vectors. Neither describes structured metadata filter conditions or shows that filtering preserves recall or latency. Missing for 10: documentation of structured metadata filter operators, any description of a filtered-HNSW or pre-filtering strategy, recall and latency evidence under restrictive filters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter vector search by structured metadata conditions without wrecking recall or latency

citations.quote: It combines vector similarity search with keyword filtering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and reranking in a single query interface.
Weaviate is an open-source vector database (Go) that stores objects, vectors, and inverted indexes
